implementation.position_convention: window_start_0_to_len_minus_1_from_validity_mask; PAD contributes nothing; asserted against store position_ids-1
implementation.layout: right_padded_contiguous_prefix; unpadded token-wise LN/QKV/FFN; causal product in padded [B,T] layout
implementation.attention_impl: explicit_fp32_causal_math (lower-triangular incl. diagonal); no SDPA unless equivalence tests pass
implementation.qkv_init: one fused Linear(d,3d); Xavier-uniform applied separately to each [d,d] slice (Wq,Wk,Wv)
implementation.microbatch: 256 unless the post-Gate-C benchmark shows 128x2 faster (systems choice, frozen before training)
implementation.tying: UNTIED: separate output table W_out [K,d] (N(0,0.02) from the common generator) + output bias; class j <-> item token j+3
implementation.input: z = LayerNorm_in(E[item] + P[pos] (+ rich side residual)), then input dropout; no sqrt(d) scale
implementation.recentering: after every optimizer step: W_out -= mean_row(W_out); b -= mean(b)  (loss-neutral)
implementation.monitoring: update_agg every 100 updates logs E/W_out common-mode and median row norms (8192-row sample) and bias mean/std
